releases.name: Low-Budget Repairs
releases.summary:
"There have been other games about spiders, but never one that so thoroughly celebrates the beauty and deadly elegance of their work." - jayisgames.com

Arachnophilia was a ground breaking online game we released in 2008. It has been one of our most successful games to date, and we're very excited to finally make it available on the iPhone and iPod Touch!

Arachnophilia is an arcade-style simulation of a night in the life of a spider. Your goal is to survive for as long as possible by building a web to trap and devour the hapless insects who blunder into it. How long can you survive, and how many different insects will you meet along the way? Can you become a legend among spiders and capture the bat? Compare your score on the global leaderboards or against your Facebook friends, and share it through Twitter, Facebook, or email.

But it's not all about survival - along with helpful gameplay tips, you're also treated to an array of interesting facts about spiders and the other creatures you encounter. And for a more relaxed experience you can indulge in "Art Mode", where you have unlimited webbing and an undisturbed canvas.

Arachnophilia is also available for the iPad.

Element Idle
releases.summary: Click the atom, earn particles, evolve through all 118 elements of the periodic table. A free idle/clicker game with a deep skill tree, prestige system, and Steam achievements.

releases.name: Kingdoms vs Zombies
releases.summary: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

releases.name: Purr in Bloom
releases.summary: A cozy logic puzzle about finding hidden cats among blooming gardens. Follow simple clues, mark impossible spots, and discover every mischievous kitty!

releases.name: Don't Blush
releases.summary: An escape room unveils the Inner Realm. Don't Blush: An emotional FMV mystery game. Unravel the secrets of six mysterious women.

releases.name: Aquasushi Cat
releases.summary: Make the aquariums nervous — in an incremental game that grows bigger with every dive. Set up your own kitchen and take on the world in Arcade Mode to claim the crown. It won't always be easy. But it's worth it.

releases.name: Pixel Airport Tycoon 3D
releases.summary: Build and manage your own airport – in classic 2D or full 3D. From your first runway to an international hub: terminals, cargo, customs, weather & de-icing, airline contracts, staff and research. Plan smart and become the world's best airport tycoon!
